topography.project_purpose: Algo-Stables. Structurally: 46 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 8 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (upgradeabilityproxy, proxy, baseupgradeabilityproxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
